H2.label: human_presence_v2
prompt_translation: Keep identity geometry unchanged while adding believable facial soft tissue, realistic eyelid and eye-socket structure, regional skin response, subtle natural asymmetry, non-uniform hair grouping, and photographic camera response.
Realism must come from anatomy, material response, and optics rather than larger pores, aging, or stronger sharpening.

H3.label: photographic_presence
prompt_translation: Push toward convincing photographed-human presence while preserving locked facial geometry and character identity.

region_rules.forehead: smooth fine texture with restrained sebum reflection
region_rules.eyelids: thin skin, believable thickness and fold structure, subtle lower-lid volume
region_rules.nose: slightly stronger specular response with fine texture around alae
region_rules.inner_cheeks: subtle microtexture and gentle color variation
region_rules.lips: independent moist material with fine lip lines
region_rules.jaw_neck: natural soft-tissue transition without razor-sharp contour

camera_rules: face focus is strongest while peripheral cloth may resolve slightly softer
